verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not show that an agent can answer affordability questions from live Wave ledger data through an API. The only API reference is a crawl-wall note naming developer.waveapps.com as the home of a GraphQL API, but its documentation returned 403, so nothing about ledger or report endpoints could be verified. Wave's public pages document no API, MCP, or agent surface, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The reports feature (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) exists only as UI functionality, with no programmatic or agent access shown.
